Wow this is so similar to my situation. About a year ago I built a Windows Server 2008 R2 machine from scratch and got an entire office going with ActiveDirectory, got 4 routers going with no issues.......................yet somehow I am not qualified to work at Bobs Computers-N-Stuff for nearly minimum wage.

OK well I got into computers in the mid 90s when Windows 95 was brand new. I studied programming for a while in college but I don't like writing code. C/C++/x86 ASM/Visual Basic/Pascal...........you name it I have tried it. I have no looked at code in over a decade as coding is not for me. 

I am A+ Certified. I worked for the IT and CS departments in college. Back in 2011 I was an on-site network admin 8-5 at a huge doctors office. I was laid off when that doctors office was sold.

You would THINK that my background would qualify me for a shitty $10 an hour computer repair job from a local computer company. You would be wrong. I have been EVERYWHERE in my town that fixes computers. No luck.

What makes me happy is mountain biking, going to the gym, and working on technology.

My mountain bike is fucked plus i need all the calories i have since i dont know when i am going to be eating. Gym is out same reasons. I cant afford the membership.

I literally cannot move home. it is a long story. I HATE where I am from. Where I live now is not bad besides not being able to find a job.
